catalogue_metadata.scope_notes: Structural, architectural, behavioral, and domain patterns extracted from the continuous architecture system CLI runner and governance core.
analysis_limits: Excluded agentic workflows, prompt contracts, and subagent orchestration logic
Analysis focused on Python runtime package cas_runner and static governance knowledge layout

system_map.overview: cas_runner is a Continuous Architecture System (CAS) CLI runner and governance runtime. It orchestrates architecture validation, computes governance health from metrics, evaluates transitions, and projects steering knowledge into developer workspaces.

layers.name: application
layers.purpose: Workflow execution orchestration, bootstrapping, and governance action services

layers.name: domain
layers.purpose: Governance data models, compliance engines, transition registries, and health evaluation rules

layers.name: infrastructure
layers.purpose: External telemetry parsing adapters, filesystem workspace synchronization, and LLM transport clients

tools_and_integrations.purpose: Data validation, strongly-typed domain model parsing, and schema generation
Pluggable provider-agnostic unified model invocation client

state_and_memory.scope: cas-knowledge directory tree containing markdown decisions, YAML configs, and JSON rule contexts

patterns.name: Pydantic Domain Entity Modeling
patterns.summary: Formalizes continuous architecture domain entities and evaluation artifacts as strongly-typed Pydantic models with explicit validation and field specifications.
patterns.intent: Ensure immutable type safety, strict schema validation, and transparent serialization across the governance lifecycle.
patterns.context: The system processes metrics, risk assessments, compliance violations, and governance actions originating from diverse CI and runtime sources.
forces: Need to guarantee schemas without writing manual type guards
Data ingested from raw JSON/YAML requires deterministic validation errors
patterns.solution: Define core governance data constructs (findings, metrics, actions, exceptions) as Pydantic models inheriting from BaseModel with explicit typed fields and descriptive metadata.
implementation_signals: Subclasses of pydantic.BaseModel defining domain models
Field specifications for compliance findings, inventory, and health states

evidence.note: Defines rich typed models for tracking architectural state and compliance findings.

benefits: Type-safe boundary across domain engines and storage layers
costs: Runtime validation overhead on large metric payloads
Coupling of domain definitions to the Pydantic dependency
failure_modes: Uncaught validation errors interrupting batch execution if unexpected external fields appear

patterns.name: Transition Registry State Machine
patterns.summary: Coordinates valid governance state transitions using a dedicated transition registry and action execution engine.
patterns.intent: Decouple governance lifecycle transitions from the engine execution logic via an explicit registry of permitted state shifts.
patterns.context: Governance artifacts (such as architectural decisions, rules, and exceptions) transition across stages (proposed, active, retired) requiring validation at each step.
forces: Preventing illegal transitions between governance states
Need to register new transitions without altering core action engine dispatch loops
patterns.solution: Implement a TransitionRegistry that holds authorized states and transitions, queried by GovernanceActionEngine prior to executing domain modifications.
implementation_signals: Validation checks enforcing state legality in GovernanceActionEngine

evidence.note: Maintains transition mappings and validates action executions against permissible state progressions.

benefits: Clear audit trail for allowed state progressions
costs: Indirection through registry lookup before executing actions
failure_modes: Stale registry state causing valid operational actions to be rejected

patterns.name: Canonical Telemetry Adapter
patterns.summary: Ingests disparate external telemetry trace formats into a standardized internal span representation via specialized adapters.
patterns.intent: Normalize heterogeneous traces and logs from external agents or CI runners into a uniform data model for downstream dashboarding and cost calculation.
patterns.context: Different systems (e.g., CodingAgent, Antigravity, ClaudeCode) emit metrics and telemetry in varying schemas, timestamps, and cost notations.
forces: Heterogeneous upstream log schemas must not pollute internal health and cost calculation logic
New agent systems must be easily supportable without changing dashboard consumers
patterns.solution: Establish a canonical representation (AgentTelemetrySpan) and implement specialized adapter classes that parse, convert timestamps, and extract standardized properties.
implementation_signals: Base or family of adapter classes per source system

evidence.note: Converts distinct span sources into canonical AgentTelemetrySpan models.

benefits: Downstream analytics remain pure and decoupled from external schema formats
Isolated failure boundaries per telemetry vendor
costs: Redundant transformation logic for each new telemetry provider
failure_modes: Silent data loss if source format changes timestamp layout unexpectedly

patterns.name: Layered CLI-Runner-Service Architecture
patterns.summary: Maintains strict unidirectional separation between CLI presentation, flow execution orchestration, and domain services.
patterns.intent: Prevent presentation logic from entangling domain business logic and provide a headless pipeline runner usable in CI and interactive environments.
patterns.context: cas_runner needs to be invoked via command-line arguments, CI workflows, and programmatic tests.
forces: CLI commands should remain lean entrypoints
Domain actions must run headless without terminal UI dependencies
patterns.solution: Organize execution into clear tiers: CLI parses user input, FlowRunner manages multi-step execution lifecycle, and GovernanceActionService coordinates domain logic.
implementation_signals: cli.py delegates directly to FlowRunner or service instances
Domain service classes (GovernanceActionService) contain no CLI argument parsers

evidence.note: Entry point handling argument resolution and delegating flow control.
Orchestrates step progression and pipeline execution.
Coordinates application-level governance operations independently of presentation.

benefits: Headless CI execution without CLI harness
High unit testability of individual services
costs: Parameter passing boilerplate through intermediate orchestration layers
failure_modes: Command-line exit codes misaligned with deep domain exceptions if error propagation is unhandled

patterns.name: Declarative Health Evaluation Engine
patterns.summary: Computes health categories and diagnostic reasons via pure functional evaluation against domain indicators.
patterns.intent: Decouple health calculation logic from metrics collection and UI presentation by evaluating state through pure deterministic functions.
patterns.context: Governance dashboards and automated gates need to assess repository health based on compliance violations, drift, and throughput.
forces: Health state calculations must be deterministic and testable without mock databases
Evaluation rules must clearly explain why a system transitioned into a degraded or unhealthy state
patterns.solution: Define an enumeration for categorical health states (HealthStatus) accompanied by pure evaluation functions (calculate_health, get_health_reasons) that return statuses alongside actionable justification strings.
implementation_signals: Enum definition for HealthStatus (e.g., HEALTHY, DEGRADED, UNHEALTHY)
calculate_health and get_health_reasons functions accepting metrics models and returning status with explanation lists

evidence.note: Pure functional evaluation of system health indicators and diagnostic reason lists.

benefits: Highly deterministic and easily unit-tested against simulated metric vectors
Clear auditability for automated CI gate failures
costs: Must keep calculation criteria synchronized with changing compliance thresholds
failure_modes: Threshold boundary mismatches causing false positive degraded alerts

patterns.name: Workspace Overlay Bootstrapping
patterns.summary: Initializes and updates consumer workspaces by creating symlinks, projecting template directories, and merging declarative configuration blocks.
patterns.intent: Ensure developer workspaces adhere to global architectural governance standards without overwriting local project customizations.
patterns.context: Repositories incorporating CAS require local governance links, Claude agent configs, and onboarding checklists linked to canonical central templates.
forces: Standardized files must be shared across repositories without drift
Local config files (like .claude/settings.json) contain local overrides that cannot be blindly clobbered
patterns.solution: Provide specialized merge and overlay routines (e.g. merge_cas_governance_block, merge_claude_settings, _create_symlink_or_copy) to atomically link canonical artifacts and update configuration manifests.
implementation_signals: Functions targeting symlink creation with copy fallbacks
JSON/YAML block merge functions that preserve existing non-CAS keys

evidence.note: Performs symlink linking, onboarding checklist rendering, and non-destructive JSON setting merges.

benefits: Non-destructive updates preserve local developer customizations
Instant synchronization of global patterns via symlinking
costs: Direct coupling to target filesystem layout and permissions
Symlink compatibility edge cases across different operating systems
failure_modes: Corrupted symlinks if central cas-knowledge paths move relative to workspace

patterns.name: Test Double Client Substitution
patterns.summary: Isolates external transport dependencies behind interchangeable production and mock client implementations.
patterns.intent: Allow execution of flow pipelines in air-gapped test environments without invoking live external network APIs.
patterns.context: Flow execution and governance actions may rely on model inference or external providers during pipeline runs.
forces: Live network calls are slow, nondeterministic, and costly during CI testing
Engine code should not be polluted with test flags
patterns.solution: Provide structural parity between LiteLLMClient and MockLLMClient enabling direct substitution in tests and local simulations.
implementation_signals: Parallel client classes adhering to an identical call signature
Mock client providing deterministic synthesized responses

evidence.note: Production network client communicating with LiteLLM.
Offline test double client supporting deterministic dry-run verification.

benefits: Enables zero-cost offline test suites in CI
costs: Maintenance burden keeping mock interface signature in parity with production client
failure_modes: Mock client diverges from production API response schema leading to green tests that fail in production

anti_patterns.name: Tightly Coupled Filesystem Configuration Mutation
symptoms: Bootstrap logic directly performs raw file IO, JSON deserialization, and path resolution inside procedural functions without a virtual filesystem abstraction
Platform-specific symlink handling mixed directly into domain bootstrap routines
impact: Difficult to unit test bootstrapping without creating temporary directories on disk
Potential for permission and path resolution failures across varied operating systems (e.g. Windows vs Linux)
suggested_remediation: Introduce an abstract FileSystem / WorkspaceStorage interface with LocalFileSystem and InvertedMemoryFileSystem implementations

anti_patterns.name: Monolithic Telemetry Adapter Collection
symptoms: Multiple concrete vendor telemetry adapters (CodingAgent, Antigravity, ClaudeCode) are implemented in a single module without a formal pluggable provider registry
Internal parsing logic for all formats bundled within one file
impact: Adding support for new trace formats requires editing shared adapter files, increasing merge conflict risks
Bloats dashboard module dependencies with external formatting utilities
suggested_remediation: Refactor telemetry adapters into a dedicated package (cas_runner.dashboard.telemetry.*) with an extensible registration decorator

cross_cutting_concerns.name: Observability and Distributed Tracing
cross_cutting_concerns.description: Standardized span reporting and telemetry normalization using OpenTelemetry SDK to track governance execution durations and model usage costs.

cross_cutting_concerns.name: Configuration Validation & Integrity
cross_cutting_concerns.description: JSONSchema and Pydantic validation used across CI scripts and Python modules to verify workflow specifications and workspace settings.

open_questions.question: Is there a formal abstract base class or protocol defined for the LLM clients (LiteLLMClient and MockLLMClient) to enforce compile-time structural typing?
open_questions.context: Both clients exist in src/cas_runner/llm/ but explicit inheritance from an abstract base class was not visible in the top-level symbols.

open_questions.question: How does the system handle concurrent modifications to cas-knowledge governance files during simultaneous CI workflow runs?
open_questions.context: Governance action services write to markdown/YAML files directly; multi-branch execution may require distributed locking or pull request serialization.
